You are finishing a video fix that another agent completed but did not commit. Its transcript is gone, so this prompt is the full specification.

Work from: `/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype` (branch `feat/pan-african-org`)

## What already happened (verified, do not redo)

This repo builds 60-second HyperFrames tutorial videos. A bug was found and fixed: every beat composition built an **unpaused, unregistered** `gsap.timeline()`, violating the HyperFrames contract that each composition register exactly one `gsap.timeline({ paused: true })` at `window.__timelines["<id>"]`. Unregistered timelines run in wall-clock time during render instead of being seeked, so the cursor and subtitle animations finished before frame capture. **They had never appeared in any delivered video.**

A prior agent applied the three-line registration fix to 14 compositions (7 in `tutorial-video/compositions/`, 7 in `pan-african-org/video-en/compositions/`), and discovered the fix alone had *no effect* until it also removed a dead `<script type="module">` Pretext block from `tutorial-video/compositions/beat-01-dashboard.html` — that block broke sub-composition inlining for the whole project.

It regenerated `tutorial-video-fr` and `tutorial-video-es` and re-rendered all three ministry videos with posters. **I verified the result myself**: the English render at t=8s now shows "Welcome to the Labour Market Portal." in the lower third with the cursor visible, and the French at t=8s shows "Bienvenue sur le Portail du Marché du Travail." with accents intact.

**All of that work is sitting uncommitted in the working tree.** Do not redo it, do not re-render, do not regenerate.

## Task 1 — remove the same dead blocks from three org compositions

These three still carry the dead Pretext module block and will break the org video's render later, in exactly the way just diagnosed:

- `pan-african-org/video-en/compositions/beat-01-dashboard.html` — **two** module blocks (one at ~line 68 importing Pretext from `https://esm.sh/@chenglou/pretext`, one at ~line 1253 that consumes `window.Pretext`, uses top-level `await`, and calls `document.querySelectorAll('[data-pretext]')`)
- `pan-african-org/video-en/compositions/beat-03-recruiter.html` — one block
- `pan-african-org/video-en/compositions/beat-04-seeker.html` — one block

I have already confirmed these are dead: in `beat-01-dashboard.html`, `data-pretext` appears exactly once in the entire file, at line 1258, and only as the selector string *inside the block being deleted*. No element anywhere carries that attribute. The other two files have zero occurrences.

Remove the blocks, including the `<!-- Pretext fallback -->` comment where present. Use the already-applied removal in `tutorial-video/compositions/beat-01-dashboard.html` as your exact reference — match it, do not improvise a different edit.

Change nothing else in these files. The timeline registration lines are already correct; leave every tween, duration, easing, id, class and `data-*` attribute alone.

## Task 2 — verify

- `npx hyperframes check` in `pan-african-org/video-en` — confirm no new findings versus before your edit.
- `npx hyperframes snapshot --at 10,30,40` in `pan-african-org/video-en` and look at the frames. Confirm the compositions still inline correctly and show the real portal pages, not blank frames.
- `npm test` must still pass.
- **Do not render the org video.** That is a later task.

## Task 3 — commit everything

Stage and commit the whole change set:

- the 14 timeline-registration fixes (7 ministry + 7 org)
- the dead-module removals (ministry `beat-01`, plus your three org beats)
- the regenerated `tutorial-video-fr` and `tutorial-video-es` compositions
- the three fresh ministry renders and their posters

`git status` shows the previous fr/es render files as **deleted** — that is expected. The build script wipes its output directory, and the prior agent replaced those renders with fresh verified ones rather than restoring stale files. Stage the deletions alongside the new files so the commit is coherent and does not leave orphaned removals.

Use this commit message:

```
fix(video): register paused timelines so cursor and subtitles render

Every beat built an unpaused, unregistered gsap.timeline(), so the
renderer could not seek it — the animations ran in wall-clock time and
finished before frame capture. Cursor and subtitles have never appeared
in any delivered video. hyperframes check reported no errors.

A dead <script type="module"> Pretext block also broke sub-composition
inlining; the registration fix alone had no effect until it was removed.

Verified: subtitles and cursor now visible at t=6/8/11s in en/fr/es.
```

Before committing, confirm nothing under `pan-african-org/{en,fr,es}/` or the root ministry site pages (`*.html`, `/fr`, `/es`) changed — this work touches video projects only.

## Report

Append a section to `.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-20-pan-african-org-site-and-video/task-11b-report.md` covering the three org removals, the check/snapshot results, and the final commit contents.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status, commit (short SHA + subject), a one-line verification summary, any concerns, and the report file path.
